title: Guard records-page-ready reads the PR's own repo, so a cloud child-repo runner can mark a batch ready
why: hooks/guard.py's records-page-ready check (update_pull_request branch) fetches the head in the session's own checkout, not the PR's repo, so every child-repo batch is refused when marked ready.
source: coordinator 22:55 CST Nov 11; incident degen #643, batch runner 11, 22:54 CST
note: Possible false alarm: every child-repo batch hits it. Fix: read owner/repo from tool_input and fetch from that repo. Test: a degen PR marked ready from a claude-settings checkout passes when its records page is ready. First wave after the guard test split, beside scratchpad-owner-follow-ups. Unblocked: the guard test split merged (39e378f15, 07:16 CST Nov 12). Lane started 07:20 CST Nov 12 (coordinator, Sonnet, medium).
